title: Exact $L^2$-growth profiles for the free wave equation: Sharp constants, critical regularity, and local energy decay
summary: We study the large-time behavior of the $L^2$-norm of solutions to the free wave equation on $\mathbb{R}^N$ and, more generally, their homogeneous Sobolev norms of negative order. We refine and extend the results of R. Ikehata [J. Hyperbolic Differ. Equ. 20 (2023)] who identified and quantified the infinite-time $L^2$-growth of free waves in dimensions $N=1,2$.
